proposals.title: Calmer timer screen
proposals.summary: Every timer gets a slow ring that empties as it counts down and turns green when it's done. Box breathing becomes a square that fills as you breathe in and empties as you breathe out, with the step and a 4-3-2-1 count inside it.

proposals.title: Smoother list: progress line and gentle checks
proposals.summary: A thin "2 of 14 done" line fills in as you go, and checking things off no longer jumps the page, just a soft pop and a tiny tap. The bottom buttons get a solid background so the list doesn't show through, and the home button becomes a clean house icon that matches the gear.

proposals.title: Website: one shared settings gear
proposals.summary: Right now the Flag Hub gear covers the website's theme button, so its four looks can't be reached. This makes that button the one shared gear with Look and Flag, like Panic Button and Music Space.

proposals.title: Website: find a game box
proposals.summary: With about 190 games, the Games page gets a search box that opens the right consoles and highlights the matches as you type. Also fixes "1 players" and gives the Xbox sections proper names.

proposals.title: Whose turn it is, Merge button, archive, photo button
proposals.summary: Reworked with your notes and ready to merge (no second approval, like you asked): every card now says in one line whose turn it is, and ready ones get a Merge on GitHub button. Old ones fold into an Archive, and screenshots open from a small photo button with a glowing ring on the change.

proposals.title: No more long-press or right-click flags
proposals.summary: Long-press on your phone and right-click on a computer go back to normal in every app, so they stop planting flags by accident. Planting still works from the gear's Flag button with Aim.

proposals.title: Map rooms take turns: particles, mist, or swaying grass
proposals.summary: Walking room to room on the adventure map now changes the ambience: floating particles, soft mist (steam on lava), or grass that sways and bends as your hero walks by. Colors match each story, and your existing maps stay exactly the same.

proposals.title: Folded Night shift shows its mode
proposals.summary: When you fold the Night shift section, a small Off / Light / Big pill on the right of the heading lights up the current mode. Opened, it looks exactly like before.

proposals.title: Lane bar tucks in between the flag and gear
proposals.summary: On your phone, once the Cloud / PC / Ideas bar sticks to the top it slides toward the center, so the flag and gear buttons sit beside it instead of on top. Scroll back up and it widens out again; desktop is unchanged.

proposals.title: Lesson pop-up keeps its audio player docked
proposals.summary: The narration player now sits along the bottom of the lesson pop-up and stays there while you scroll. At the end of the reading it settles under the Back to the question button.

proposals.title: Website: steady game window arrows, Start and Games icons back
proposals.summary: The game window's arrows now only switch games: no scroll bars pop up and the box keeps one size. The missing Start and Games icons are back (the chest for Games); there's no spinning globe art in the wizard yet, so Start shows the book for now.

proposals.title: Phone pings say what it is and who sent it
proposals.summary: A game request ping now reads "Game request from Steven" with the game as the text, instead of "New report", and ideas, bugs and guests get their own labels. It reaches other drives with the next published wizard version.

proposals.title: Scrolls of Wisdom switch moves to Options
proposals.summary: The Scrolls of Wisdom on/off switch moves out of Filters and into Options, under a Battle heading next to Exploration map. It still saves per deck, and Filters is now just chapters and Starred/Misses/New.

proposals.title: Large widget gets the counts look
proposals.summary: Reworked for your large widget instead of the medium one: three count tiles (Claude with a cloud icon, Claude with a computer icon, and for you, no ideas), then a big red number of proposals waiting on you from the cloud or PC with the first few listed, then your open flags. Your medium widget is left alone, and once you approve, the night shift emails you the script to paste into Scriptable with the steps.

proposals.title: Tidier month card and chapter header on your phone
proposals.summary: On the Path tab, the practice number now sits right beside its label and the week circles stretch across the card with the key underneath. The chapter's Test out button tucks into the corner so the description gets the full width.

proposals.title: Practice tools fit on one phone screen
proposals.summary: The Practice tab tiles are compact on your phone: small icon beside the name, short description under it. All eight tools and the warm-up fit on one screen with no scrolling, and bigger screens stay the same.

proposals.title: Lift calendar rings today and shows what is coming up
proposals.summary: The Lift days calendar puts a soft ring on today and shows upcoming lift days as faint dotted boxes, and today never counts as missed before it's over. The line under it now says how many lift days are done so far and how many are still ahead.

proposals.title: Rest-day note on the workout page reads cleanly
proposals.summary: Opening a session on a rest day used to show an awkward note with odd gaps around the day. Now it reads as one sentence: Rest day today. This is Tuesday's session, opened early.

proposals.title: Back 10 / forward 10 buttons on the narration players
proposals.summary: Every narration player, and the floating mini player, now has a back 10 seconds and forward 10 seconds button beside play. Your lock screen and headphone skip buttons jump 10 seconds too.

proposals.title: Shared settings gear comes back
proposals.summary: Tapping the gear in Music Space rolls out the shared tray again (Look, Flag, Sound, more), like your other apps, instead of jumping straight to the settings page. The v2.4 profiles update accidentally dropped the shared kit, and this puts it back exactly as it was.

proposals.title: Christmas look for December
proposals.summary: From Dec 1 to 31 Study Decks dresses up on its own like it does for Halloween: snow, twinkling lights across the top, a red ornament on the wordmark that jingles when you tap it, and candy-cane progress bars. A Christmas decorations switch sits under the Halloween one in the gear's Look panel.
